do_if.value: not global.$JKEOC_B298Pending? or not global.$JKEOC_B298Pending.$ship? or not global.$JKEOC_B298Pending.$ship.exists

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B298][RAW_FLEET_INIT] interval=5min stations_per_cycle=1 assignment_changes_per_cycle=1 max_pins_per_resource=3 routine_source_scan=0 bounded_source_check=after_6_low_cycles cooldown=30min blueprint_scan=0'

set_value.name: $record
set_value.exact: table[$station=$station, $stationname=$station.name, $ware=$ware, $wareid=$ware, $warename=$ware.name, $transport=if $ware.waretransport == waretransport.solid then 'SOLID' else 'LIQUID', $rate=0, $status='MONITORING', $detail='Do Everything is monitoring this mineable station input.', $ships=[], $laststock=$station.cargo.{$ware}.count, $misses=0, $deliveries=0, $lastcycle=player.age]

set_value.name: $basketok
set_value.exact: $ship.defaultorder? and $ship.defaultorder.id == 'MiningRoutine' and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket? and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override? and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.count == 1 and ($ship.defaultorder.$warebasket == $record.$ware or @$ship.defaultorder.$warebasket.indexof.{$record.$ware}) and ($ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override == $record.$ware or @$ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.indexof.{$record.$ware})

do_if.value: $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket? and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override? and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.count == 1 and ($ship.defaultorder.$warebasket == $record.$ware or @$ship.defaultorder.$warebasket.indexof.{$record.$ware}) and ($ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override == $record.$ware or @$ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.indexof.{$record.$ware})

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: 'Delayed read-back proved %1 is now pinned to %2 through the native manual mining override.'.[$ship.name, $record.$warename]

set_value.name: $record.$status
set_value.exact: if $record.$pinunproven? and $record.$pinunproven then 'ASSIGNED - PIN NOT PROVEN' else if $validships.count ge $desired then 'PINNED COVERAGE' else if $validships.count gt 0 then 'MORE COVERAGE NEEDED' else 'SHIP NEEDED'

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: '%1 pinned miner(s) / %2 recommended; stock %3 / target %4; low-stock observations %5; observed stock increases %6; live station resource=%7.'.[$validships.count, $desired, $stock, $target, $record.$misses, if $record.$deliveries? then $record.$deliveries else 0, $currentresource]

do_if.value: $record.$misses ge 6 and $sourcechecks == 0 and (not $record.$lastsourcecheck? or player.age - $record.$lastsourcecheck ge 30min)

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: $record.$detail + ' A native resource source remains discoverable; EOC will continue slow recovery.'

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: $record.$detail + ' X4 returned no discoverable source for this ware at the bounded source check.'

show_notification.text: 'EOC RESOURCE WARNING: No current source for %1 was discoverable for %2. No ship or construction change was guessed.'.[$record.$warename, $record.$stationname]

do_if.value: not $record.$recoveryowner? and $managed and $changes == 0 and not global.$JKEOC_B298Pending? and not ($record.$pinunproven? and $record.$pinunproven) and $validships.count lt $desired

not $selected? and $candidate.exists and $candidate != player.ship and $candidate.owner == faction.player and $candidate.isclass.ship and $candidate.isoperational and not $candidate.isunit and not $candidate.isclass.ship_xs and not $candidate.commander and not $candidate.subordinates.count and $candidate.primarypurpose == purpose.mine and $candidate.waretransport.indexof.{$record.$ware.waretransport}

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: 'Registered miner %1 selected for %2; EOC is verifying its station assignment and exact ware basket.'.[$selected.name, $record.$warename]

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: $record.$detail + ' No idle registered compatible miner is available; EOC did not buy or take a ship.'

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B298][RAW_FLEET_CYCLE] station_index=%1 stations=%2 wares=%3 ships=%4 changes=%5 source_checks=%6 managed=%7 elapsed_seconds=%8 interval=5min source_check_trigger=6_low_cycles source_check_cooldown=30min blueprint_scan=0'.[global.$JKEOC_B298StationIndex, $stationschecked, $wareschecked, $shipschecked, $changes, $sourcechecks, $managed, player.age - $started]

set_value.name: $recoverysafe
set_value.exact: global.$JKEOC_B371Routes? and global.$JKEOC_B371Routes.indexof.{$route} and $route.$token == $pending.$recoverytoken and $actor.exists and $actor.owner == faction.player and $actor != player.ship and $actor.isoperational and $actor.pilot.exists and not $actor.hasorderloop and $actor.orders.count == 0 and $actor.tradeorders.count == 0 and (not $actor.defaultorder.exists or $actor.defaultorder.id == 'Wait' or $actor.defaultorder.id == 'MiningRoutine') and (not @$actor.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.count or @$actor.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.indexof.{$pending.$ware}) and (global.$JKEOC_B76AssignmentMode == 'AUTO-ASSIGN REGISTERED' or (global.$JKEOC_B76AssignmentMode == 'APPROVAL REQUIRED' and @$route.$approvedtoken == $route.$token))

set_value.name: $pinned
set_value.exact: $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket? and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override? and $ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.count == 1 and ($ship.defaultorder.$warebasket == $pending.$ware or @$ship.defaultorder.$warebasket.indexof.{$pending.$ware}) and ($ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override == $pending.$ware or @$ship.defaultorder.$warebasket_override.indexof.{$pending.$ware})

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: '%1 is assigned to %2 and pinned to %3; EOC is awaiting stock/delivery evidence.'.[$ship.name, $record.$stationname, $record.$warename]

show_notification.text: 'EOC RESOURCE FLEET: %1 pinned to %2 for %3. Monitoring delivery evidence.'.[$ship.name, $record.$stationname, $record.$warename]

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B304][RAW_PIN_VERIFY] result=PASS order=MiningRoutine manual_override=EXACT ui_readback=PUSHED station=%1 ware=%2 ship=%3'.[$record.$stationname, $record.$wareid, $ship.name]

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: '%1 is assigned; X4 has not exposed a writable mining ware basket yet. Bounded pin check %2 of 4 is waiting.'.[$ship.name, $pending.$attempts]

set_value.name: $record.$detail
set_value.exact: '%1 is assigned to the station, but X4 did not expose or retain an exact ware basket. EOC will not claim permanent resource pinning.'.[$ship.name]

show_notification.text: 'EOC WARNING: %1 was assigned to %2, but exact %3 pinning could not be proven.'.[$ship.name, $record.$stationname, $record.$warename]

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B304][RAW_PIN_VERIFY] result=UNPROVEN order_or_override_not_retained ui_readback=PUSHED station=%1 ware=%2 ship=%3'.[$record.$stationname, $record.$wareid, $ship.name]

set_value.name: $pending.$record.$detail
set_value.exact: 'BLOCKED: The station mining assignment did not remain valid through exact-resource pin verification.'

do_if.value: global.$JKEOC_B298Pending? and (not global.$JKEOC_B298Pending.$attempts? or global.$JKEOC_B298Pending.$attempts ge 4 or $pinned)

set_value.name: $route.$status
set_value.exact: if @$pinned then 'PINNED - AWAITING DELIVERY' else 'PIN NOT PROVEN'

set_value.name: $route.$overview
set_value.exact: if @$pinned then 'The exact native mining resource pin is confirmed. I am watching the station stock; assignment is not delivery.' else 'The mining pin was not confirmed. The ship or its orders changed, or native readback did not retain the exact resource. No delivery success is claimed.'
